Omaha sound third-party notices
=================================

Binary builds of the client ship this file because these licenses require
the copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer to travel with the program.
The same texts are in the source tree under code/thirdparty/.

The SADIE KU100 HRTF set is Apache License 2.0. Its license and citation
ship with the data at main/sound/prom/hrtf/SADIE_LICENSE.txt and README.txt.

miniaudio (David Reid) is used for device playback. It is offered as the
Unlicense or MIT No Attribution. Neither requires a notice in this file.
The full text is at the end of code/thirdparty/miniaudio/miniaudio.h.
